surfaceContract: Owner-scoped read-only CEX portfolio with explicit CEX custody and KYC; trade, withdrawal and transfer remain forbidden.

connectorStore.claim: No production connector catalog, credential binding, permission proof or balance snapshot exists.

telegramBot.claim: The deployed /mywallet flow reads verified external wallets only and has no KAIROS connector or CEX custody lane.

site.claim: Cookie-capable owner-scoped APIs exist, but deployed dashboard templates expose no CEX portfolio or connector lifecycle UI.

miniApp.claim: Deployed UI renders three custody lanes plus owner-scoped source/event/disconnect views; credential input and connect remain deliberately disabled.

admin.claim: Laravel has no CEX resource; the separate KAIROS operator UI exposes legacy exchange fields and LIVE-CAPABLE wording while its legacy save/test endpoints reject with 409 and do not operate the connector lifecycle.

api.claim: Scoped Ed25519 internal list/events/connect/disconnect and owner-scoped Relay list/events/disconnect/aggregate routes are deployed; no approved user connect endpoint exists.

native.claim: The native-wallet scaffold has no CEX connector or portfolio client surface.

positiveControls: KAIROS internal routes require scoped Ed25519 service identity, bounded bodies and replay state.
Relay derives an opaque owner principal from the authenticated web user and never accepts ownerRef from request input.
Connector reads and disconnect are owner-filtered; foreign source identifiers are masked as not found.
Permission policy requires read=true and trade, withdrawal and transfer=false; credential use requires a proof no older than 15 minutes.
Disconnect first blocks use, removes the vault reference, clears balances and preserves a sanitized lifecycle event.
Mini App labels external balances as KYC and custody at the exchange and says they are read-only.
riskFindings: Relay portfolio treats any dictionary KAIROS response as available and does not validate connector-list.v1 or items as a list; malformed contract data can become an EMPTY, complete CEX lane.
Bybit balance parsing does not bound the exchange timestamp against observation time, and the store accepts FRESH observations without maximum age; stale provider evidence can be labelled fresh.
Balance decimal validation permits negative values, so malformed negative provider balances can be rendered as legitimate FRESH amounts.
Cookie-authenticated CEX disconnect has no explicit CSRF token binding; SameSite=Lax is not acceptance evidence for the mutation.

Event retention is prune-on-access or append rather than an independently proven scheduled deletion, while revoked connector metadata and idempotency records persist without an accepted deletion or backup-expiry contract.
The only implemented provider transport is fixed to Bybit TESTNET; no production CEX permission, balance or disconnect lifecycle has been observed.
Connect exists only on the internal KAIROS boundary; Relay and customer UI intentionally accept no CEX credential, so a production user cannot create a connector.
The KAIROS operator UI claims CEX LIVE-CAPABLE and exposes legacy credential fields although legacy save/test endpoints are disabled and the connector lifecycle is not represented there.

The frozen connector contract requires positions, asset/network identity and rate-limit state, but current projection is balances-only, network may be null, and no positions or explicit rate-limit state is returned.
Connector persistence is a service-local JSON file plus encrypted vault rather than the target PostgreSQL transactional source of truth, and no observed production backup/restore evidence covers it.
Sanitized lifecycle events omit sourceId, so multiple connectors for one provider are ambiguous in the owner UI.
Production Relay main differs from checkout even though the reviewed CEX route block is present.

focusedTests.scope: hermetic signed connector lifecycle, owner isolation, permission/balance/disconnect, management UI, unified portfolio and E1 readiness; synthetic testnet evidence only

compile.scope: KAIROS connector store/main and Relay unified portfolio/service identity

limitations: No authenticated production customer route was called.
No production credential, connector row, provider balance or revoke lifecycle exists to accept.
Point observations are not continuous monitoring.

malformed response can appear empty and complete
cookie disconnect lacks explicit CSRF binding
